==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Nightfall
| minimum = 6
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to the [[Zehlon Reach]].
* Gather petals from a swamp flower plant.
* See [[Barlom]] [[Dye Trader]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 Experience
* 100 Gold
* 5 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Random Vial of [[Dye]]

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Barlom [Dye Trader]'''
:''"Oh dear!  I'm almost out of swamp flower petals, but I can't stop stirring to find more or this dye I'm working on will be ruined!  If you have time, I'd be willing to give you a fresh vial of dye from my most recent batch if you bring me some '''petals''' from the '''[[Swamp Flower|swamp flowers]]''' growing in the '''Zehlon Reach'''.  Think you have some time for that?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'm on it.
|decline = I have no use for dye.  Thanks anyway.
|ask = The '''swamp flower''' has the only blooms with petals of the correct color for my dye.  Gather some of these petals and bring them to me.  I'll give you a vial of dye from my most recent batch. }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Barlom [Dye Trader]'''
:''"Excellent!  Perfect!  This is a tricky recipe, but well worth the extra effort.  Here's your dye.  Please remember me the next time you need to dye your armor!  I sell the most vibrant dyes around...and at very competitive prices."''
